questions.prompt: What value should be inserted between each original neighboring pair?

choices.label: The greatest common divisor of those two node values.
choices.feedback: The problem requires the largest positive integer dividing both original neighboring values.

choices.label: Their least common multiple.
choices.feedback: The problem requires the largest positive integer dividing both original neighboring values.

choices.label: Their sum.
choices.feedback: The problem requires the largest positive integer dividing both original neighboring values.

questions.prompt: After inserting the new node, where should traversal continue?

choices.label: At the saved next original node.
choices.feedback: Skipping the inserted node preserves the original adjacent pairs and prevents repeatedly inserting between newly created nodes.

choices.label: At the inserted node, treating it as an original node.
choices.feedback: Skipping the inserted node preserves the original adjacent pairs and prevents repeatedly inserting between newly created nodes.

choices.label: At the head of the list again.
choices.feedback: Skipping the inserted node preserves the original adjacent pairs and prevents repeatedly inserting between newly created nodes.
